desc:
Once considered vulgar, AlphaGo demonstrated that this move is ideal. Even before AlphaGo, opinion about this move had been changing. Various professionals had played it between 1997 and 2012 and found the result to be satisfactory.

See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 35, AlphaGo Master (W) vs. Jiang Weijie 9p (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zjEZDmYqRPg&t=774s).
